These pages hold the information architecture for a later, cited history. They are **not** a finished narrative.

The commissioning brief suggested this working lineage so later evidence has a place to land:

**institutional or agency care → disability-led independent-living experiments → Creekview → Enhanced Consumer Participation Model (ECPM) → direct individualized funding → CSIL design and pilot → a province-wide program.**

That sentence is a **research proposition**. This archive has not yet inspected the sources needed to confirm, qualify, or replace it.

Working dates to accommodate, also unconfirmed here:

| Working date | Placeholder | Status on this site |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early 1980s | Independent-living / community-living advocacy in British Columbia | Open question |
| c. 1985 | Creekview | Later public sources inspected; 1985 opening attested, details conflict |
| c. 1987 | Creekview evaluation | Wanted; 1987 evaluation attested by Haw 1989; copy not held |
| c. 1990 | ECPM material and *Keys on Freedom* | ECPM 1990 manual cited in a later bibliography; *Keys* still unconfirmed |
| c. 1993 | CSIL design / authorization | Contested with 1994; no 1990s ministry file recovered |
| c. 1994 | CSIL pilot; possible ECPM training revision | Contested with 1993; 1994 ECPM revision still unverified |
| c. 1995 | Province-wide availability | Open question |

Use the [timeline](../timeline.qmd) for the same propositions in date order, and [sources](../sources/index.qmd) for catalogue records.
